#Millets #MilletsBenefits #MilletsSideEffects #MilletNutrition #HealthyEating #MilletsForDiabetes #MilletsForWeightLoss #DrLakshmi #HealthyDiet #iDreamHealth 

Are millets really healthier than rice and wheat? What happens when you eat millets every day? Discover the surprising health benefits, possible side effects, and nutritional facts about millets in this informative video featuring Dr. Lakshmi on iDream Health.

Millets such as Foxtail Millet, Finger Millet (Ragi), Pearl Millet (Bajra), Little Millet, Barnyard Millet, and Kodo Millet are rich in important nutrients, including fiber, minerals, and plant-based protein.

Dr. Lakshmi discusses Millet Health Benefits, Millet Side Effects, Diabetes Management, Weight Loss, Digestion, and Healthy Eating Habits.

Learn how millets can support a balanced diet, why portion control matters, and what precautions to take when consuming them regularly. Excessive consumption or sudden increases in fiber may cause digestive discomfort.
